description: One member's independent answer to the task.

claims.description: Key claims made in answer. Empty only for trivial tasks.

items.description:
An atomic, checkable statement extracted by the member from its own answer.

Claims are what peer reviewers and the chair compare across members; they make
agreement and disagreement detectable without diffing prose.

id.description: Member-local id, e.g. "c1". Unique within one Stage1Answer.

text.description: The claim as a single self-contained sentence.

support.description: Brief justification or source the member relies on; None if none.

assumptions.description: Assumptions the member made about an under-specified task.
